summary: Test suite covers all major features (parsing, license checking, config loading, report generation, CLI, workflow structure) with clear organization and good fixture strategy. However, coverage is incomplete: CLI argument parsing lacks tests for missing --config/--licenses and unknown arguments; several validation error paths in parse.ts (non-object JSON, non-string versions, invalid requirements lines) are unexercised; config/database loading doesn't test format edge cases (missing arrays, non-string values, invalid JSON). Design is solid with readable tests and proper mocking of license lookups, but rigor suffers from untested error scenarios—the implementation throws meaningful errors for these cases, but the test suite doesn't verify them, risking regressions. Would catch happy-path regressions but miss error-handling bugs.
